# What the System pages judge

<!-- Generated by book/scripts/gen-judgements.bash from site-template/ui/mgmt/staticcontent/js/system/judge.js. Do not edit. -->

The Overview and Operations pages of the management interface give every measure one of four states. The states are shown as a word and a mark, so that the color is never the only carrier.

| State | Word | Mark |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ok | Normal | ● |
| warn | Attention | ▲ |
| bad | Problem | ■ |
| unknown | Not reported | ○ |

A measure that the appliance does not report is shown as Not reported. It is never shown as Normal and it never outranks a finding.

## The thresholds that the judgements use

The constant `THRESHOLDS` in `judge.js` holds every limit that a judgement uses. Each row shows the name, the value in the file, and the comment the file writes above it.

| Name | Value | Comment |
| :--- | ---: | :--- |
| `daysLeftAttention` | 30 | Storage: a store fills slowly, so the days left matter first; the free share is a backstop for space that something other than the archiver uses. |
| `daysLeftProblem` | 7 |  |
| `freeAttentionPercent` | 5 |  |
| `freeProblemPercent` | 3 |  |
| `writeAttentionPercent` | 50 | The share of the write period the engine needs for writing; 100 is the point where samples are lost. |
| `writeProblemPercent` | 100 |  |
| `heapFloorAttention` | 70 | The lowest heap after a collection: its level and its rise over the day, in points of the maximum heap. |
| `heapFloorProblem` | 90 |  |
| `heapFloorRiseAttention` | 5 |  |
| `disconnectedSeconds` | 3600 | A PV disconnected for longer than this is a finding; a shorter loss is often a restart. |
| `lossWindowSeconds` | 30 | PVs of one host that lost their connection within this many seconds of each other are one event. |
| `etlBusyProblemPercent` | 200 | The ETL: a busy share of its interval at or above this is a pass that cannot keep up. |

## What each judgement measures

| Judgement | Attention | Problem |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Days left in the stores | fewer than `daysLeftAttention` days | fewer than `daysLeftProblem` days |
| Free share of a device | below `freeAttentionPercent` percent | below `freeProblemPercent` percent |
| Write time of the engine, as a share of the write period | at or above `writeAttentionPercent` percent | at or above `writeProblemPercent` percent |
| Lowest heap after a collection | at or above `heapFloorAttention` percent of the maximum, or a rise of at least `heapFloorRiseAttention` points in a day | at or above `heapFloorProblem` percent of the maximum |
| A PV disconnected | for more than `disconnectedSeconds` seconds | no PV is connected |
| An ETL pass | the last pass overran its interval, was late, or a job failed | busy for at least `etlBusyProblemPercent` percent of its interval |
| Dropped samples | none | any PV in the four dropped-event reports |
| Components | the components run different versions | a component is not running |

The Operations page repeats the thresholds that the judgements use next to their basis, in its Configuration section.
